# Calling registered customers to install the app and make their first entries

## 1. Key details

- **Language of the call:** English
- **App address:** [www.example-ledger.in](https://www.example-ledger.in)
- **Support (WhatsApp):** [+91 90000 00000](tel:+919000000000)
- **Price:** The app is free. There is no charge for the first year.

---

## 2. How the agent should speak

Say who you are, why you are calling, and ask whether now is a good time. Keep it under twenty seconds.

If the customer's name is known, use it once at the start — "Hello **[name]**".

Do not explain the whole dashboard on this call.

| Say this | Not this | Why |
|---|---|---|
| phone | handset | nobody says handset |
| app | application software | too long |

> "Hello, I am calling from Example Ledger about your new account."

### If he says he is busy

Ask when to call back, note the time, thank him and end the call.

## 3. Installing on Android

1. Open the **Play Store**.
2. Search for *Example Ledger*.
3. Tap **Install** and wait for it to finish.

**The Play Store question — this will come up in almost every call**

The app is only on the Play Store and the App Store. It is not on any other site.

## 4. Opening hours

Our support team answers on WhatsApp from 9 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday.
